mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an agent of the company and stands in a position analogous to a trustee."
The administrator is an agent of the company and stands in a position analogous to a trustee.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a consequence of due accreditation by the Commission."
The authorisation is a consequence of due accreditation by the Commission.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which floating charge is converted into fixed (specific) security."
Crystallisation is the process by which floating charge is converted into fixed (specific) security.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person under 18 years of age. (b) any person found by a Court of competent jurisdiction to be of unsound mind. (c) a body corporate except statutory corporations."
An infant is a person under 18 years of age. (b) any person found by a Court of competent jurisdiction to be of unsound mind. (c) a body corporate except statutory corporations.

fib: ______ is an officer of the court too.
The official receiver is an officer of the court too.
______ means the creditor is accelerating the repayment of the debt and this step can potentially set off cross default provisions the debtor might have with other creditors.
Reaction by Exit means the creditor is accelerating the repayment of the debt and this step can potentially set off cross default provisions the debtor might have with other creditors.
